A [[Star Wars CCG]] turn consists of six '''phases'''. Their order is Activate, Control, Deploy, Battle, Move and Draw. The Dark Side normally takes the first turn, then players alternate. Card text can change the standard procedure.<ref name="rb20">[[Media:Decipher Rulebook 2.0.pdf|Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0]], Decipher (November 1998), pp. 4–12. [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

== Activate phase ==

Count the Force icons for your side on all locations on the table and add one for personal Force. You may activate up to that amount by moving cards one at a time, face down, from the top of your [[Life Force#Reserve Deck|Reserve Deck]] to your [[Life Force#Force Pile|Force Pile]].<ref name="rb20" />

== Control phase ==

You normally control a location if you have total ability of at least one there and your opponent does not. You may initiate a [[Force drain|Force drain]] at each location you control. The base drain is the number of your opponent's Force icons at that location. Finish resolving each drain before starting the next.<ref name="rb20" />

== Deploy phase ==

During this phase you can deploy cards from your hand. To deploy a character, vehicle or starship, pay its deploy cost in Force. You can generally deploy these cards at locations where you have Force icons or presence. Locations have no deploy cost.<ref name="rb20" />

== Battle phase ==

You may spend one Force to start a [[Battle|battle]] at a location where both players have total ability of at least one. You can start at most one battle at each location per turn. A battle has three segments in order: weapons, power and damage.<ref name="rb20" />

== Move phase ==

You may move your characters, vehicles and starships where their movement rules allow. Methods include landspeed, docking bay transit, shuttling, hyperspeed, landing and taking off, and embarking and disembarking.<ref name="rb20" />

== Draw phase ==

You may draw any number of cards from your Force Pile into your hand, one at a time. There is no hand-size limit. Unspent cards can remain in your Force Pile for later use.<ref name="rb20" />

== End of turn ==

After the player announces the end of their turn, both players put their [[Life Force#Used Pile|Used Piles]] beneath their Reserve Decks.<ref name="rb20" />
